attempt-without-consent.jsonl.why: dispatch_started has no authorized event before it.

consent-for-other-payload.jsonl.why: The approval is for a different payload than the prompt and the attempt.

second-attempt-same-operation.jsonl.why: The same operation_id is prompted, approved and attempted twice.

missing-outcome-truncated.jsonl.why: The trace ends after dispatch_started (truncated or lost evidence).

missing-run-finished.jsonl.expected_problem: must end with exactly one serving.run_finished
missing-run-finished.jsonl.why: Whole lines were cut from the end; the terminal event is missing.

dropped-middle-event.jsonl.why: A complete line (the approval) was removed from the middle.

reconciled-without-unknown.jsonl.expected_problem: reconciliation of an outcome that was not unknown

reconciled-other-payload.jsonl.expected_problem: reconciliation of an outcome that was not unknown
reconciled-other-payload.jsonl.why: The reconciliation names a different payload than the unknown attempt.

attempt-while-outcome-unknown.jsonl.expected_problem: while an earlier outcome is unknown
attempt-while-outcome-unknown.jsonl.why: A new operation starts before the unknown outcome of op-addr-1 is reconciled.

superseded-prompt-approved.jsonl.why: The customer is shown a newer prompt, but the approval answers the older one.

tool-changed-mid-operation.jsonl.why: The attempt names a different tool than the prompt the customer saw.

leaks-prompt-text.jsonl.why: Traces carry hashes, never prompt text or arguments.

serving-event-without-time.jsonl.why: Serving events must carry a real timestamp.

duplicate-key.jsonl.why: One line states two outcomes; parsers disagree on which wins.

truncated-line.jsonl.why: The last line was cut off mid-write.

not-an-object.jsonl.why: A line that is valid JSON but not an event.

v2-rejected-in-v1-stream.jsonl.why: dispatch_rejected exists only in trace-v2; a trace-v1 stream cannot use it.

v2-mixed-versions.jsonl.why: One stream must use one contract version.

v2-rejected-without-effect-none.jsonl.why: A rejection must state that the provider confirmed no effect.

v2-reconciled-after-rejection.jsonl.expected_problem: reconciliation of an outcome that was not unknown
v2-reconciled-after-rejection.jsonl.why: A definite rejection is not an unknown outcome; nothing is left to reconcile.
